name: Split Pine Log
description: Wind-snapped Scots pine log section lying on the ground: orange-brown bark cylinder with dark soil-contact underside, exposed pale heartwood face at the splintered break end, three upright wood-fibre splinters, a moss patch on the upper surface, and a branch-knot scar.

parts.name: Main log cylinder — orange-brown pine bark
parts.note: r=140 mm (prop_radius_mm), h=1200 mm (prop_section_length_mm). axis='z' → cylinder lies along Z. Floor-anchored: centre-y = r so bottom sits at y=0.

parts.name: Dark soil-contact bark underside
parts.note: Embedded in lower cylinder (y 0–0.06); adds ground-shadow and dark lower-bark tone. Curved cylinder surface does not produce coplanar z-fight with bevelBox faces.

parts.name: Exposed heartwood cross-section at break end
parts.note: Centre z=0.59 → spans z=0.57 to z=0.61 (30 mm embedded into log end, 10 mm proud); shows pale exposed heartwood at break face.

parts.name: Central upward splinter at break (tallest)
parts.note: Protrudes from break end: base near y=0.24 (top of log y=0.28); extends to y=0.44 (160 mm above log). z=0.605–0.655, 5 mm gap from cylinder end cap prevents z-fight.

parts.name: Left flanking splinter at break
parts.note: Darker weathered-wood tone; slightly shorter than central splinter.

parts.name: Pleurozium moss strip on upper log surface (mid-section)
parts.note: Centre y=0.275, h=0.04 → spans y=0.255–0.295; sits mostly inside cylinder top (y=0.28), protrudes 15 mm proud. Pleurozium/зеленомошник moss colonises upper face of fallen bor logs (dossier#moss_coverage).

parts.name: Dark branch-knot scar on upper bark (near clean end)
parts.note: Embedded in upper surface of log (y=0.225–0.315, cylinder top at y=0.28); reads as a proud dark bark knot or branch-stub scar.

needs: Sub-adult Pinus sylvestris DBH — prop diameter 280 mm is below the sourced mature-stand range (500–1300 mm); no forestry citation for younger-stand diameter (dossier#log_trunk)
Wind-throw log section length — 1200 mm is a design value, not sourced (dossier#log_trunk)
Snap-fracture splinter geometry — splinter h=200 mm, count=3 are design estimates; no sourced data on conifer wind-snap fracture morphology (dossier#split_break)
Moss patch thickness — 30 mm is a design estimate; EUNIS 1283 gives species presence but no measured geometry for this application (dossier#moss_coverage)
